dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Brothers and sisters! In celebration of a victory hard won, and to remember those heroes who gave their lives to see it come to pass, let us convene at Stage Tepetl, as is our custom!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Let us raise a glass together, move our feet together, cheer our triumph together, and shower our heroes with gems and blessings as one!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Come one, come all, for a celebration that can't be missed! Such a great day demands we all come together. No one's to be left out!"
